'''Yong tau foo''' ({{zh|t=釀豆腐|s=酿豆腐}}; also spelled ''yong tao foo'', ''yong tau fu'', ''yong tau hu'' or ''yong tofu''; ''ก๋วยเตี๋ยวแคะ'' in Thailand) is a [[Hakka cuisine|Hakka Chinese dish]] consisting primarily of [[tofu]] filled with [[ground meat]] mixture or [[surimi|fish paste]]. Variations on this dish feature vegetables and mushrooms, rather than tofu, stuffed with ground meat or fish paste. Yong tau foo is eaten in numerous ways, either dry with a sauce or served as a [[asian soup|soup dish]].

It is commonly found in parts of [[China]], [[Indonesia]], [[Malaysia]], [[Singapore]], [[Thailand]], [[Vietnam]],<ref name="Hẻm Gems"/> and in cities where there are large [[Hakka people|Hakka]] populations.<ref name=Phu>{{cite web|url=http://topicstock.pantip.com/library/topicstock/2012/09/K12677594/K12677594.html|language=thai|date=2012-09-19|author=ภูผาฟ้าทะเล|title=ย้งเที้ยวฟู เย็นตาโฟ|work=[[Pantip.com]]}}</ref>
